scope: Postprocessing existing native onset trace only, no simulation or source change. Consecutive frame deltas demonstrate why published absolute offsets cannot serve as temporal lane velocity.

selectedPathContract.capturePoint: After takeover/re-entry launch rebasing and bypass folding, before launch decay and lane approach.
selectedPathContract.query: Evaluate retained selected state at the requested station; use the existing base laneReach hook and RACING_LINE.edgeMargin=2.4 local road bound.
selectedPathContract.currentAndPreview: Both locations query the same retained state; never reconstruct current intent from a clipped preview point.
selectedPathContract.temporalMotion: At one fixed station and frozen geometry/width, subtract locally clipped old/new selected positions and divide by dt.
selectedPathContract.spatialMotion: The selected path tangent is separate from its temporal displacement; moving station/lookahead must not contribute to temporal velocity.
selectedPathContract.oldGPClamp: Old current-only width-1.4 clamp differs from the existing base width-2.4 path contract. Resolving ownership uses the base query; this is not a newly tuned margin.

lifecycleReview: Invalidate before each base update, including LIGHTS/reaction early return.
Invalidate in Bike rider-down branch, which returns before base update.
Capture after placement or long-gap reanchor so a pose reset does not become a velocity impulse.
Bypass folding must preserve total lane offset without inventing motion.
Pit and preparing-pit absolute corridors do not expose a selected-road snapshot. In-pit offset approach is not the published pitLine target and must not create6m/s road motion.
Publish the current selection before limitSpeed; both planRecovery and subsequent steering consume the same snapshot.
Nonpositive or nonfinite dt must not divide into a rate.
Keep direct helper calls without a live road selection on the existing fallback contract.

scopeReview.GPOnlyConsumption: Appropriate for this GP regression; preserve nonGP/offroad specialized contracts until independently tested.
scopeReview.edgeGeometryLimit: Temporal endpoint clipping alone is not proof of exact spatial edge curvature; the state oracle separately checks selected local tangent.
